overview_description.description:
Anchorage Digital is a regulated crypto platform that provides institutions with integrated financial services and infrastructure solutions. With the only federally chartered crypto bank in the US, as well as Anchorage Digital Singapore, which offers equivalent security and service standards, Anchorage Digital provides institutions an unparalleled combination of secure custody, regulatory compliance, product breadth, and client service. 

Founded in 2017, Anchorage Digital is valued at over $3 billion with funding from leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC—Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital is remote-friendly with offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on Twitter @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

about_short_description.short_description: Anchorage Digital is a regulated crypto platform that provides institutions with integrated financial services and infrastructure solutions.

product.name: Anchorage Digital Prime
product.description: An institutional digital asset platform combining trading, financing, custody, staking, governance, and settlement services through one integrated interface.

product.name: Custody
product.description: A qualified custody service for safeguarding institutional digital assets and USD, with controls for asset storage, transfers, and on-chain participation.

product.name: Trading and financing
product.description: Institutional spot and agency trading with access to digital asset liquidity, margin, derivatives, and financing-related services.

product.name: Atlas settlement network
product.description: An on-chain settlement network that coordinates digital asset trade settlement while reducing counterparty, delivery, and bankruptcy exposure.

product.name: Staking
product.description: Institutional staking services that let customers delegate supported proof-of-stake assets and receive network rewards while using custody infrastructure.

product.name: Banking services
product.description: Digital asset banking infrastructure for holding, sending, and receiving cash and cryptocurrencies through an integrated institutional interface.
